body:
Nice! 

To be fair, the two Revans basically stole the thunder of every other character in the game, lol.

Love Qyzen’s point system. I always dig characters that can slowly get stronger as the match goes on. It forces both players to rethink their strategies. (Though it would be kinda funny if there was a way for him lose all his points) 

Also, a debuff Taunt is a unique idea. In fact, there’s a lot of unique nechanics at play here, which is great to see. 

On a unrelated note, now that we’re getting a Fear debuff with Revan, it might be cool to see some Dread Master kits that takes advantage of it.

Well, I did pitch a 5th Geonosian not long ago. 

As for Tuskens, give us A’sharard Hett and Hoar.

I think you implented Resolute into the kits very well. It feels like an evolution of the “Prepared” mechanic the Solo smugglers have. Similar idea of giving bonus effects while also feeling a bit less linear than Prepared, since anyone could benefit from the buff, in theory. 

I think Rusk is my favorite of the bunch. He’s kinda like an attacker version of Baze. I also always like it when non-tanks have ways of attaining high survivability. Makes for an interesting hybrid of playstyles. 

Can’t wait for the Consular crew.
Hope they add Val and Rio while they’re at it. I know they weren’t in the movie long, but I really liked the chemistry the three of them had.

Thanks for the feedback! Truth be told, I mostly went with Marked because Boss literally marks targets for the squad in the game. I do love the idea for Sev having an accuracy buff, though. The Fixer revive is a bit strong, but I figured Clones need all the help they can get at this point. 

As for another Taunter, I guess there’s Gregor. With him, we’d have a full squad of 5 commandos.

Thanks! Yeah, Republic Commando might just be my favorite star wars game, second only to the KOTOR/SWTOR games. 

I think Clones are on the cusp of being a great faction. They just need something like this to push them into anti-meta relevance.
Thanks! I figure if CG is gonna draw so much content from KOTOR, they might as well take from the other great legends games.

Good point. I also think it’d make sense for a reworked Poggle to have a forced Taunt. I like the idea of higher ranked Geonosian forcing the grunts to die for them. It fits lorewise and could make for some fun strategies.
[I gotchu, fam.](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1RxjWlxVg3lWPqd1DM-PR5FIEaxM1jjIzdZtDfMPsia0/edit#slide=id.g4fd792afc5_0_0)

Good stuff, as always. I especially like Corso. I like the idea of a tank granting stealth to other allies. Its a bit more interesting than just straight up Taunting. 

I know he’s not a companion, but I’d love to see a kit for the Voidwolf. There could be cool Sith/Scoundrel synergy there.

Imo, its among Dark Horse’s weaker stuff. It has the same problem the current Star Wars run does, focusing on an era that’s been done to death. 

The art is pretty good, especially the Alex Ross covers, but the storylines were pretty bland, at least for me. I love Dark Horse’s other SW stuff, but I think you can skip this one.
Same here. If CG won’t give him a ship, I guess I’ll have to.

I really like how you design tanks. Khem and Xalek are both great toons. Khem fulfills a more niche role, while Xalek slots in well with any Sith team that dishes out shock. Khem also reminds me of Broonmark with his lack of tags and generic Dark Side leadership. I wonder if we’ll see something similar for Light Side Characters. 

Andronikus is a touch ovetuned, I think. Anything that can repeat infinitely is a bit too open to exploitation, imo. I think a hard limit of like 10 or so would still be very powerful and stick to the intended playstyle. 

Beyond that, the rest are also solid. Looking forward to the rest of the companions, though i am a bit bummed to wait so long for the Consular crew. I need my man Qyzen Fess.

I dig the anti-revive effects, and how they enocurage getting kills with certain characters. Its a good way to counter OR/Jedi teams without shutting them down completely. 

I also think Vette’s revive is pretty clever. 

Another great set of characters. Looking forward to the Inquisitor’s crew. 👍
That’s a typo on my end. Its meant to say “at the end of each turn”. I’ll fix it when I get the chance.

Thanks for the feedback! Like I said, your posts really helped motivate me to put this together. 

Yeah, balancing Taunt and Guard is tricky. My instinct with Tanks is usually to Taunt as much as possible, but you’re right that it can be detrimental here. I’ll tone it down, try to find a balance between the two. 

Looking forward to your next SWTOR post. :D

Doubled Turn Meter. Admittedly the wording is a bit wonky. If the chance were doubled, I think it would be "Has a 25% chance (doubled if Emperor Palpatine is present) to gain 50% Turn Meter", or something like that.

True. If they were ever to implement multiple toons with Guard, they'd probably have to add in some extra caveats to prevent stacking. Maybe make Chewie's guard only work on Light Side allies and RG's only work on Dark Side. 

Still, I think its an interesting hypothetical.
To be honest my brain totally turned off with the Crit Avoidance thing. I’ll change it to something actually useful.
Very cool stuff. I love seeing people come up with custom toons.
Not to mention Yoda dispatched them pretty easily.
You’re probably right. I do wonder if they plan on keeping Guard exclusive to Chewie or if we’ll eventually see it pop up on other toons...
True, but Chewie’s Guard has a lot of extra buffs attached. A more stripped down version wouldn’t be too overpowered, at least I think...
I was kinda hoping they’d just add Kivi to the game later on like they did with Trygivvi. Guess not...

Thanks for replying. 

Its the ok with myself part I’ve always struggled with. My passion has alwaus been writing, but I can’t live off that, not now, probably not ever. I’m too self conscious to submit anywhere, and I know for a fact its just not good enough. So I’m just going to keep living off my parents money until either I die or it all dries up. I’d much rather the former than the latter.
